# HiveBlot blind extraction benchmark: report

**Status (2026-10-18):** the design is pre-registered, papers are drawn, the PDFs are frozen and
Stage 1 has run. The model stage is waiting on a CLI login, and the human annotation is out to
the team.

**No accuracy result exists yet.** The results section is generated by `score_blind.py` into
`report/RESULTS.md` after annotation, and is never typed by hand.

## 1. What is being measured

We test whether HiveBlot's existing extraction system recovers Western-blot facts from papers it
has never seen. The reference is labels made independently by a person with wet-lab Western-blot
experience, who reads only the PDF.

The facts scored are:
- protein identity (gene symbol)
- modification type and phospho site
- cell line or sample
- treatment
- band present/absent in each lane

| Item | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| System version | `western_blot_miner/` at `f77d311`. Production (`3839ee3`) runs the same extraction code; only docs differ. | `PREREGISTRATION.md` §2 |
| Model | `claude-opus-5`, the production default | Render env check 2026-10-18 (`WBM_MODEL` unset) |
| Settings | DPI 350, candidate score 0.35, model score 0.65, escalation off, concurrency 1, live UniProt | `run_extraction.py`, `pdf_preprocess.py:15-17` |
| Database writes | None. Outputs stay in a private directory and are sealed by SHA-256. | `run_extraction.py`, `SEALED_OUTPUTS.sha256` |

## 2. Papers (frozen before any extraction or annotation)

**Selection:**
- **Pool:** 26 papers in `eval/candidates.json` (assembled 2026-08-12). 15 are eligible: Western
  blot, explicit CC BY, not a protocol, not retracted, never processed by HiveBlot.
- **Draw:** `random.Random(20261018)` over the sorted eligible list (`draw.py`).
- **PDFs:** fetched by the system's own fetcher, with SHA-256 recorded in `papers.json`.

| Draw rank | PMCID | Paper | Pages | PDF source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PMC9283986 | Lopez-Toledo et al. 2022, *Front Aging Neurosci*: PSEN1-mutant patient fibroblasts | 23 | system fetcher (Europe PMC listed) | frozen |
| 2 | PMC5328321 | Yang et al. 2017, *Onco Targets Ther*: β-catenin in renal cell carcinoma | 14 | system fetcher (publisher page) | frozen |
| 3 | PMC7948984 | *J Biol Chem* 2021: the 89-kDa PARP1 cleavage fragment and AIF-mediated apoptosis | 13 | manual browser download (the fetcher failed on every source) | frozen |
| 4 | PMC4393234 | Bojovic et al. 2015, *PLoS ONE*: immediate-early genes in rat spinal cord | 17 | system fetcher (OpenAlex) | frozen |
| 8 | PMC7757890 | Bortolami et al. 2020, *PLoS ONE*: mTOR and LC3 in liver tissue | 24 | system fetcher | dropped: rank 3 was obtained (`DEVIATIONS.md` A2) |

Ranks 5-7 also failed automatic download. That is an access failure only, logged in
`papers.json`.

**Difficulty:** the pool was built to be diverse and adversarial. It includes tissue samples,
patient fibroblasts and cleavage products, so it is likely harder than an average paper.

## 3. Measured so far (automated side only)

Stage 1 is the deterministic OpenCV panel detection. It runs before any model call.

| PMCID | Pages | Candidate crops | Sent to model | Stage 1 time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PMC9283986 | 23 | 85 | 6 | 8.7 s |
| PMC5328321 | 14 | 72 | 28 | 5.4 s |
| PMC4393234 | 17 | 49 | 3 | 5.5 s |
| PMC7948984 | 13 | 88 | 20 | 12.7 s |
| **Total** | 67 | 294 | 57 | 32.3 s |

Source: `PRIV/runs/<PMCID>/timing.json`.

**Panel recall can't be judged yet.** It needs the human inventory: we don't yet know how many
real Western-blot panels each paper has. A paper with few crops sent to the model, such as
PMC4393234 with 3, may turn out to have low recall. The report will show that as it is.

## 5. Results

Pending. When generated, `report/RESULTS.md` will contain:
- panel recall (`found / inventoried`)
- per-field accuracy, precision of assertions, abstained and not-found, all with denominators,
  pooled and per paper
- the count of incorrect assertions (wrong values, unsupported values, spurious records)
- automated time against manual time
- raw and adjudicated versions

## 6. How to reproduce

See `RUNBOOK.md`. The scorer refuses to run if any sealed output file changed, and it reports
any diff of the system code from `f77d311`.

## 7. Limits to state alongside every number

- 4 papers drawn from an adversarial pool, scored against one primary annotator. This is not a
  literature-wide accuracy figure.
- Only main-text Western-blot panels are scored. Supplementary figures are out of scope.
- If extraction uses the local `claude_cli` transport instead of production's `anthropic` API
  transport, the model and prompts are the same but the image hand-off differs (`DEVIATIONS.md`
  A1.5).
- Field matching uses fixed normalizations. Notation differences are settled only by the
  annotator's adjudication, and raw numbers are always reported next to adjudicated ones.
